temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Shirley appears somber; in conversation she says it has been tough, wonders if more could have been done, and finds it hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley cared for the patient and may be sad, but she has not yet confirmed how deeply affected Shirley is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected by the loss is confirmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply grieving the patient's death, is struggling to let go, and may be quietly questioning whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley, reassure her that they did everything they could, and help her focus on the good care and moments of joy.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During coffee break, Shirley explicitly says she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different approach might have helped; she appreciates Sara's reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the funeral, Sara believes Shirley is grieving and struggling to let go, and may be questioning the care decisions, but she has not yet confirmed that Shirley feels personally responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley's sense of responsibility and guilt becomes explicit.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible for the patient's outcome and is carrying the burden of treatment decisions; reassurance is welcome but not fully accepted yet.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, sad, and motivated to ease Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Understand Shirley's feelings, reassure her that decisions were made with the available information, and help her not carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley remains reserved and minimally expressive; when confronted, Shirley says she fears seeming unprofessional or weak, but agrees to try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their coffee-break talk, Sara believes Shirley feels responsible and burdened, and may be holding back emotionally, though she is not sure why.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Sara confirms Shirley is suppressing feelings and learns Shirley fears appearing unprofessional or weak; Shirley also shows willingness to try opening up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is emotionally reserved because she fears judgment or weakness, but with support she may allow herself to express feelings.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to open up, reassure her that emotions are not a weakness, and offer friendship and a safe space.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley tells Sara the prior conversation was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well, accepts the apology, and says continued talking helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After confronting Shirley, Sara believes Shirley may be trying to open up, but Sara worries her approach was too harsh and may have strained the friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley was somewhat uncomfortable but not alienated; she accepts Sara's apology and values continued talks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley understands Sara's good intentions, appreciates the apology, and wants their supportive conversations to continue; the friendship remains intact.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Remorseful and worried, then relieved, grateful, and warm.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Apologize, mend the friendship, and remain available for Shirley in whatever way she needs.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved; Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support and agrees to weekend plans.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the apology, Sara believes Shirley understands her support, values their talks, and may still be recovering but is willing to keep communicating.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Sara confirms Shirley is improving and that her support is helping; Shirley is open to spending time outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is feeling better, benefiting from their talks and support, and wants to deepen their connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley, spend more time together outside work, and help maintain her improvement.
